name: Cel Shading for Volumes
definition: A volume rendering technique that applies cel-shading (toon shading) effects to volumetric data, including tone detail, specular highlights, and backlighting, using a ray-casting approach with gradient-based normal estimation.
summary: Cel Shading for Volumes is a ray casting technique that replaces continuous Phong illumination with discrete, transfer-function-driven shading to produce sharp contours and stylized highlights in volumetric data.
